<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex054022026-02-1912-28-06" status="unreviewed">'o na dbang shes lnga dus gcig la 'gags pa'i rjes su de lnga skye na rgyud du ma dang |_mi skye na rgyu'i rjes su 'bras bu mi byed par 'gyur na | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3772">rnam 'grel</rs> las |
         <lg><l>de dag 'phel dang 'grib pa las ||</l>
         <l>'phel dang 'grib pa thob par 'gyur ||</l></lg>
         zhes bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na |
         
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs><note type="editorial">Gloss only in ID:5990</note></note> yid kyi dbang po dang gang tshogs pa de'i yid kyi mngon sum skye'o zer ba dang |
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">nag</rs><note type="editorial">Gloss only in ID:5990. Tentative identification of "nag" as gTsang nag pa (ID:3839), but could also stand for sKyel nag (ID:4020)</note></note> du ma skye'ang rgyud du mar mi 'gyur te | rmi lam dang 'jigs sogs goms pa'i yul gyi ngo bo la yid gsal snang skyes pa na khyad par la mi gsal ba'i rtog pa 'jug pas yid rtog bcas rtog med dus gcig la skyes kyang rgyud gnyis su mi 'gyur ba bzhin no zer ba dang |
         yang mtshan nyid bdag rkyen tha mal pa'i yid las skyes shing rtog bral ma 'khrul ba zhe bya ba dang |
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog</rs><note type="editorial">Gloss only in ID:5990</note></note> dbang po'i mngon sum dang bsdoms nas sgro 'dogs gcod do zer ba <pb edRef="inst:7423" n="21"/> dang |
         
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3780">slob dpon chos mchog</rs> 'phags pa la tshad ma yin gyi tshu rol mthong ba la ma yin no zer ba la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag du ma byas pa de dag ni don med de | 'di tshad mas ma grub pas gzhi med par khyad par la dpyod pa mi 'thad pa'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
